values.task_boundary: Deliver one supported browser-trusted localhost HTTPS flow for the separate Observatory and Runtime API, including atomic certificate handling, explicit operator trust, consistent configuration, and reproducible positive, negative, and platform proof.
deliverables: Supported localhost certificate generation, validation, trust installation, and reissue flow
Consistent Runtime API and separate Observatory HTTPS configuration and startup guidance
Chrome, curl, HTML, health/readiness, Runtime-feed, and negative certificate evidence
Platform disposition for macOS, Linux, and native Windows without inferred portability
acceptance_criteria: Chrome loads the supported Observatory URL without certificate warnings or bypasses
The committed certificate pair has correct localhost SANs, validity, Rustls compatibility, and private-key permissions
Runtime API, separate Observatory server, configured origins, docs, URLs, and probes consistently use HTTPS
Verified curl and browser paths reach Observatory HTML plus Runtime health, readiness, and feed
Missing, malformed, expired, mismatched, untrusted, or partial certificate states fail truthfully and preserve the last valid pair
No private key, token, trust-store export, or secret is committed or logged
macOS proof is retained and Linux/native Windows behavior is implemented or explicitly blocked with evidence
One exact-head review has no unresolved actionable findings
dependencies: WP-02A proving substrate terminal before implementation
Serialization with issue 5820 for shared Runtime init or TLS paths
non_goals: AWS, ACM, Route53, or Let's Encrypt issuance for localhost
Disabling TLS verification, browser warnings, or CORS policy
Serving Observatory HTML from Runtime or redesigning the Observatory
Claiming WP-03, WP-14, or WP-18A completion
